tags.label: Maintain long-term memory
tags.description: Preserve and recall important information across long chats or separate sessions.
inclusion_guidance: Use when durable conversational or character memory is a primary documented outcome.
exclusion_guidance: Do not use for ordinary chat history, bookmarks, or temporary context alone.

tags.label: Manage context limits
tags.description: Summarize, compress, budget, or selectively inject context for long conversations.
inclusion_guidance: Use when the project explicitly helps conversations remain useful within model context limits.
exclusion_guidance: Do not use merely because a project sends prompts or displays token counts.

tags.label: Retrieve relevant context
tags.description: Find and inject the memories, lore, or documents most relevant to the current scene.
inclusion_guidance: Use when selective retrieval of stored knowledge is a central user-facing purpose.
exclusion_guidance: Do not use for static prompt injection that does not select information by relevance.

tags.label: Build worlds and lore
tags.description: Create fictional settings, lore, locations, factions, or other world material.
inclusion_guidance: Use when creating or developing fictional-world content is an explicit workflow.
exclusion_guidance: Do not use solely because a project can read existing lorebook entries.

tags.label: Manage lorebooks
tags.description: Organize, edit, inspect, activate, or synchronize lorebook and World Info entries.
inclusion_guidance: Use when users directly manage collections of lore entries or their activation behavior.
exclusion_guidance: Do not use for projects that only consume lore as hidden prompt context.

tags.label: Create character cards
tags.description: Generate or author ready-to-use AI roleplay character cards.
inclusion_guidance: Use when card creation or guided character authoring is a primary documented workflow.
exclusion_guidance: Do not use for browsing, editing, or switching existing characters without creation.

tags.label: Manage characters and personas
tags.description: Edit, switch, organize, or evolve characters, personas, and their identity fields.
inclusion_guidance: Use when direct management of existing character or persona records is central.
exclusion_guidance: Do not use just because characters appear in ordinary roleplay.

tags.label: Preserve story continuity
tags.description: Keep facts, canon, timelines, and narrative details consistent over time.
inclusion_guidance: Use when avoiding contradictions or maintaining long-form narrative consistency is explicit.
exclusion_guidance: Do not use for generic quality claims without a continuity mechanism or instruction.

tags.label: Plan stories and scenes
tags.description: Develop plots, arcs, scenes, pacing, hooks, or narrative direction.
inclusion_guidance: Use when deliberate narrative planning or director-style control is a documented purpose.
exclusion_guidance: Do not use merely because the project produces roleplay prose.

tags.label: Improve writing and prose
tags.description: Strengthen prose, dialogue, style, pacing, subtext, or general writing quality.
inclusion_guidance: Use when improving authored or generated writing is a direct advertised outcome.
exclusion_guidance: Do not use for unrelated tools that happen to display generated text.

tags.label: Guide model responses
tags.description: Shape what the model says, how it behaves, or which instructions it follows.
inclusion_guidance: Use when users intentionally steer generation behavior beyond ordinary chat input.
exclusion_guidance: Do not use solely because every project ultimately sends text to a model.

tags.label: Add structured reasoning
tags.description: Introduce deliberate planning, reflection, critique, or multi-step thinking before output.
inclusion_guidance: Use when an explicit reasoning or planning process is a defining user-facing feature.
exclusion_guidance: Do not infer this from model marketing or an unexplained chain-of-thought reference.

tags.label: Manage prompts and presets
tags.description: Create, organize, lock, search, switch, or reuse prompt and preset configurations.
inclusion_guidance: Use when the project directly manages prompt or preset artifacts for users.
exclusion_guidance: Do not apply to a preset merely because the project itself contains prompt text.

tags.label: Automate roleplay workflows
tags.description: Run repeated, triggered, scheduled, or chained roleplay tasks with less manual work.
inclusion_guidance: Use when user-configurable automation or a substantial automatic workflow is central.
exclusion_guidance: Do not use for a single automatic behavior with no broader workflow purpose.

tags.label: Generate images
tags.description: Create AI-generated images, illustrations, portraits, or backgrounds for roleplay.
inclusion_guidance: Use when producing images through an AI image backend is a direct feature.
exclusion_guidance: Do not use for displaying, uploading, or organizing existing images only.

tags.label: Add visual immersion
tags.description: Enhance roleplay with sprites, portraits, backgrounds, galleries, or visual-novel presentation.
inclusion_guidance: Use when visual presentation materially changes the roleplay experience.
exclusion_guidance: Do not use for incidental icons, screenshots, or ordinary interface styling.

tags.label: Add voice interaction
tags.description: Speak to characters or hear responses through speech recognition and synthesis.
inclusion_guidance: Use when speech input or spoken character output is a substantive feature.
exclusion_guidance: Do not use for music, sound effects, or unrelated audio playback.

tags.label: Add music and audio
tags.description: Add music, ambient sound, playlists, or other non-speech audio to roleplay.
inclusion_guidance: Use when selecting, generating, or playing non-speech audio is a direct feature.
exclusion_guidance: Do not use for voice-only speech synthesis or a generic notification sound.

tags.label: Translate roleplay content
tags.description: Translate chats, cards, lore, prompts, or other roleplay material between languages.
inclusion_guidance: Use when content translation is an explicit user workflow.
exclusion_guidance: Do not use just because documentation or interface text has translations.

tags.label: Run group roleplay
tags.description: Coordinate scenes involving several AI characters in the same conversation.
inclusion_guidance: Use when group-chat behavior, responder control, or multiple active characters is explicit.
exclusion_guidance: Do not confuse multiple AI characters with multiple human users.

tags.label: Add RPG gameplay
tags.description: Add game-mastering, rules, dice, combat, progression, or other roleplaying-game mechanics.
inclusion_guidance: Use when mechanical game play is central rather than purely freeform conversation.
exclusion_guidance: Do not use merely because the project is described broadly as roleplay.

tags.label: Track characters and world state
tags.description: Track changing stats, relationships, inventory, time, facts, or scene state.
inclusion_guidance: Use when structured state is updated and surfaced or injected across turns.
exclusion_guidance: Do not use for unstructured chat memory without distinct tracked state.

tags.label: Manage maps and locations
tags.description: Represent, navigate, calculate, or update places and spatial relationships.
inclusion_guidance: Use when maps, rooms, coordinates, travel, or location state are substantive features.
exclusion_guidance: Do not use for location words that only appear in ordinary story text.

tags.label: Manage inventory and quests
tags.description: Track equipment, items, objectives, quests, or progression records.
inclusion_guidance: Use when users or the system maintain structured items or objectives over time.
exclusion_guidance: Do not infer this from a generic RPG label without documented inventory or quest behavior.

tags.label: Organize chats and messages
tags.description: Search, group, bookmark, browse, archive, or navigate conversations and messages.
inclusion_guidance: Use when conversation organization or navigation is a primary user workflow.
exclusion_guidance: Do not use for tools that only alter model-generated message content.

tags.label: Inspect prompts and generations
tags.description: View, diagnose, validate, or debug the exact inputs and outputs of model calls.
inclusion_guidance: Use when transparency, diagnostics, or validation of model calls is explicit.
exclusion_guidance: Do not use for ordinary prompt editing without an inspection or diagnostic purpose.

tags.label: Customize the interface
tags.description: Change themes, fonts, layouts, controls, panels, or other interface presentation.
inclusion_guidance: Use when users can materially personalize or replace interface presentation.
exclusion_guidance: Do not use solely because a project has a polished or distinctive interface.

tags.label: Build extensions and scripts
tags.description: Develop, execute, test, or integrate custom code that extends a roleplay frontend.
inclusion_guidance: Use when developer tooling, scripting, APIs, or extension authoring is user-facing.
exclusion_guidance: Do not use merely because the repository itself contains source code.

tags.label: Connect external services
tags.description: Bridge roleplay workflows to messaging, media, note-taking, automation, or other services.
inclusion_guidance: Use when integration with a named external product or service is a central feature.
exclusion_guidance: Do not use for ordinary model-provider API compatibility.

tags.label: Recover failed generations
tags.description: Retry, resume, or repair failed, empty, interrupted, or stalled model responses.
inclusion_guidance: Use when failure recovery is a deliberate, documented user benefit.
exclusion_guidance: Do not use for ordinary regenerate or swipe controls without failure detection.

tags.label: Manage character libraries
tags.description: Discover, search, browse, categorize, import, or maintain collections of character cards.
inclusion_guidance: Use when handling a collection of character cards is a defining workflow.
exclusion_guidance: Do not use for editing one active character or generating a new card alone.

tags.label: Move and back up data
tags.description: Import, export, synchronize, migrate, restore, or back up roleplay data.
inclusion_guidance: Use when moving or safeguarding user data is a substantial documented workflow.
exclusion_guidance: Do not use for a routine one-file import required only to install the project.

tags.label: Monitor token usage and cost
tags.description: Measure, visualize, budget, or report model token consumption and spending.
inclusion_guidance: Use when usage or cost monitoring is a user-facing purpose rather than incidental metadata.
exclusion_guidance: Do not use for context compression or a simple token counter shown during editing.

tags.label: Edit and refine messages
tags.description: Rewrite, combine, clean, expand, shorten, or otherwise revise chat messages.
inclusion_guidance: Use when users directly transform or compose message text through a dedicated workflow.
exclusion_guidance: Do not use for general prose guidance that only affects future generations.

tags.label: Increase narrative variety
tags.description: Reduce repetition and introduce fresh actions, beats, twists, or response patterns.
inclusion_guidance: Use when avoiding repetitive output or injecting deliberate variety is explicit.
exclusion_guidance: Do not use for generic creativity claims without a documented variety mechanism.

tags.label: Local-first
tags.description: Keeps its primary data and workflow on the user's own device.
inclusion_guidance: Use only when local storage or local execution is an explicit design commitment.
exclusion_guidance: Do not infer local-first behavior merely because the project can be installed locally.

tags.label: Self-hosted
tags.description: Runs as infrastructure that users deploy and operate themselves.
inclusion_guidance: Use when users are expected to deploy a server, service, or full application.
exclusion_guidance: Do not apply to an ordinary frontend extension installed inside an existing host.

tags.label: Privacy-focused
tags.description: Explicitly minimizes data exposure or gives users strong control over sensitive data.
inclusion_guidance: Use only when the project documents a concrete privacy property or protection.
exclusion_guidance: Do not infer privacy from open source, local installation, or lack of contrary evidence.

tags.label: Agentic tool use
tags.description: Lets an AI plan actions, call tools, or actively inspect and manipulate resources.
inclusion_guidance: Use when autonomous planning or model-invoked tools are explicit and functional.
exclusion_guidance: Do not use for a fixed sequence of ordinary model calls with no tool agency.

tags.label: Semantic retrieval
tags.description: Selects relevant information through embeddings, vector search, RAG, or hybrid retrieval.
inclusion_guidance: Use when semantic, vector, sparse, or hybrid retrieval is directly documented.
exclusion_guidance: Do not use for keyword-only lore activation or generic memory claims.

tags.label: Visual workflow
tags.description: Uses nodes, diagrams, canvases, maps, or drag-and-drop builders to define behavior.
inclusion_guidance: Use when a visual builder is central to authoring logic or content.
exclusion_guidance: Do not use for a normal graphical settings form or attractive dashboard.

tags.label: Multi-user
tags.description: Supports several human users, shared communities, or collaborative sessions.
inclusion_guidance: Use when multiple human participants or accounts are explicitly supported.
exclusion_guidance: Do not confuse multiple human users with a single user chatting to several AI characters.

tags.label: Mobile-friendly
tags.description: Provides an explicitly supported and usable mobile layout or mobile application.
inclusion_guidance: Use when mobile use is documented, tested, or a named feature.
exclusion_guidance: Do not infer this from responsive web technology without project evidence.

tags.label: Model-agnostic
tags.description: Works across a broad range of model providers rather than requiring one model family.
inclusion_guidance: Use when broad provider or model interchangeability is an explicit property.
exclusion_guidance: Do not use when compatibility is limited to one named family or merely untested.

tags.label: Background operation
tags.description: Runs meaningful work asynchronously or quietly without blocking the main conversation.
inclusion_guidance: Use when background or non-blocking execution is explicitly important to the workflow.
exclusion_guidance: Do not infer this from implementation details such as ordinary async functions.

tags.label: Modular and extensible
tags.description: Supports optional modules, plugins, replaceable components, or user-defined extensions.
inclusion_guidance: Use when users can meaningfully add, remove, or replace documented components.
exclusion_guidance: Do not infer modularity from a repository's internal code organization.

tags.label: Rules-driven
tags.description: Uses explicit rules, schemas, calculations, or deterministic mechanics to constrain behavior.
inclusion_guidance: Use when documented rules or mechanics materially govern project output.
exclusion_guidance: Do not use for ordinary settings validation or implicit prompt instructions.

tags.label: Multi-stage generation
tags.description: Builds a final result through multiple model calls, passes, branches, or review stages.
inclusion_guidance: Use when several distinct generation stages are explicit and central.
exclusion_guidance: Do not use for a single model response that internally reasons before answering.

tags.label: Secondary-model workflow
tags.description: Delegates supporting tasks to a separately configured model or connection.
inclusion_guidance: Use when a distinct model connection handles memory, tracking, tagging, or another side task.
exclusion_guidance: Do not use just because users may choose among several providers for the main chat.

tags.label: Non-destructive
tags.description: Preserves original content or data while applying overlays, previews, or reversible changes.
inclusion_guidance: Use when preserving originals or easy reversal is an explicit distinguishing property.
exclusion_guidance: Do not assume all editors or data tools are non-destructive.

tags.label: Multilingual
tags.description: Explicitly supports use, authoring, or interfaces in multiple languages.
inclusion_guidance: Use when multilingual use is a documented product capability.
exclusion_guidance: Do not use solely because the README is translated.

tags.label: Persistent state
tags.description: Stores structured state that survives turns, chats, sessions, or application restarts.
inclusion_guidance: Use when structured state persistence is explicit and distinct from ordinary message history.
exclusion_guidance: Do not use for temporary in-memory controls or generic long-term-memory claims alone.

tags.label: Hands-free
tags.description: Supports continuous or automatically sequenced interaction without routine button presses.
inclusion_guidance: Use when hands-free conversational operation is explicitly supported.
exclusion_guidance: Do not apply to isolated text-to-speech playback that still requires normal controls.

tags.label: Streaming-aware
tags.description: Observes, transforms, or reacts to model output while it is still streaming.
inclusion_guidance: Use when real-time handling of partial generated output is documented and meaningful.
exclusion_guidance: Do not use merely because the host frontend normally displays streaming text.
